code:
| base report decode encode inputs graph nodes models d a root model output exported objectRows refs source filepath destination readRows textValues schemaValues |
base := '/opt/git/BenjaVisionPro/catalyst-workspace/Magritte/magritte-cpp/conformance/'.
report := [ CCNativeMcpLease forRunningServers during: [
decode := [ :v |
 (v at: 'type') = 'nil' ifTrue: [ nil ] ifFalse: [
 (v at: 'type') = 'string' ifTrue: [ v at: 'value' ] ifFalse: [
 (v at: 'type') = 'class' ifTrue: [ Smalltalk globals at: (v at: 'value') asSymbol ] ifFalse: [ (v at: 'type') = 'integer' ifTrue: [ (v at: 'value') asInteger ] ifFalse: [
 (v at: 'type') = 'boolean' ifTrue: [ v at: 'value' ] ifFalse: [
 (v at: 'type') = 'array' ifTrue: [ (v at: 'value') collect: decode ] ifFalse: [ self error: 'Unsupported round-trip value' ] ] ] ] ] ] ].
encode := [ :v |
 v isNil ifTrue: [ Dictionary newFrom: { 'type' -> 'nil' } ] ifFalse: [
 v isString ifTrue: [ Dictionary newFrom: { 'type' -> 'string'. 'value' -> v } ] ifFalse: [
 v isBehavior ifTrue: [ Dictionary newFrom: { 'type' -> 'class'. 'value' -> v name asString } ] ifFalse: [ v isInteger ifTrue: [ Dictionary newFrom: { 'type' -> 'integer'. 'value' -> v asString } ] ifFalse: [
 v isArray ifTrue: [ Dictionary newFrom: { 'type' -> 'array'. 'value' -> (v collect: encode) } ] ifFalse: [
 (v == true or: [ v == false ]) ifTrue: [ Dictionary newFrom: { 'type' -> 'boolean'. 'value' -> v } ] ifFalse: [ self error: 'Unsupported round-trip result' ] ] ] ] ] ] ].
inputs := #('/private/tmp/magritte-cpp-pluggable-native.json' '/private/tmp/magritte-swift-pluggable-native.json').
inputs collect: [ :path |
 graph := NeoJSONReader fromString: path asFileReference contents.
 nodes := Dictionary new.
 (graph at: 'descriptions') do: [ :row |
  d := (Smalltalk globals at: (row at: 'class') asSymbol) new.
  (row at: 'properties') keysAndValuesDo: [ :key :value | d propertyAt: key asSymbol put: (decode value: value) ].
  row at: 'accessor' ifPresent: [ :accessor |
   a := (accessor at: 'class') = 'MADictionaryAccessor'
    ifTrue: [ MADictionaryAccessor key: (accessor at: 'key') asSymbol ]
    ifFalse: [ (accessor at: 'class') = 'MANullAccessor' ifTrue: [ MANullAccessor uuid: (decode value: (accessor at: 'uuid')) ] ifFalse: [ self error: 'Unsupported accessor' ] ].
   d accessor: a ].
  nodes at: (row at: 'id') put: d ].
 (graph at: 'descriptions') do: [ :row |
  d := nodes at: (row at: 'id').
  row at: 'children' ifPresent: [ :children | d addAll: (children collect: [ :id | nodes at: id ]) ].
  row at: 'reference' ifPresent: [ :id | d reference: (nodes at: id) ].
  row at: 'options' ifPresent: [ :options | d options: (options collect: decode) ] ].
 root := nodes at: (graph at: 'root').
 objectRows := OrderedCollection new.
 readRows := OrderedCollection new.
 (graph at: 'objects') do: [ :row |
  model := MAAdaptiveModel description: (nodes at: (row at: 'description')).
  (row at: 'values') keysAndValuesDo: [ :id :value | model write: (decode value: value) using: (nodes at: id) ].
  model magritteDescription validate: model.
  schemaValues := Dictionary new.
  (row at: 'values') keysAndValuesDo: [ :id :ignored | schemaValues at: id put: (encode value: (model readUsing: (nodes at: id))) ].
  objectRows add: (Dictionary newFrom: { 'id' -> (row at: 'id'). 'description' -> (row at: 'description'). 'values' -> schemaValues }).
  readRows add: (Dictionary newFrom: { 'id' -> (row at: 'id'). 'text' -> (root toString: model). 'values' -> schemaValues }) ].
 exported := (graph at: 'descriptions') collect: [ :row |
  | n props accessor |
  d := nodes at: (row at: 'id').
  n := Dictionary newFrom: { 'id' -> (row at: 'id'). 'class' -> d class name asString. 'conditions' -> #() }.
  props := Dictionary new.
  (row at: 'properties') keysAndValuesDo: [ :key :ignored | props at: key put: (encode value: (d propertyAt: key asSymbol)) ].
  n at: 'properties' put: props.
  d isContainer ifTrue: [ n at: 'children' put: (d children collect: [ :child | nodes keyAtIdentityValue: child ]) asArray ]
   ifFalse: [
    accessor := d accessor.
    n at: 'accessor' put: (accessor class = MADictionaryAccessor
     ifTrue: [ Dictionary newFrom: { 'class' -> accessor class name asString. 'key' -> accessor key asString } ]
     ifFalse: [ Dictionary newFrom: { 'class' -> accessor class name asString. 'uuid' -> (encode value: accessor uuid) } ]) ].
  row at: 'reference' ifPresent: [ :id | n at: 'reference' put: (nodes keyAtIdentityValue: d reference) ].
  row at: 'options' ifPresent: [ :options | n at: 'options' put: (d options collect: encode) asArray; at: 'labels' put: #() ].
  n ].
 output := Dictionary newFrom: { 'format' -> (graph at: 'format'). 'root' -> (nodes keyAtIdentityValue: root). 'descriptions' -> exported. 'objects' -> objectRows asArray }.
 destination := path copyReplaceAll: '-native.json' with: '-gt.json'.
 destination asFileReference writeStreamDo: [ :s | s truncate; nextPutAll: (NeoJSONWriter toStringPretty: output) ].
 Dictionary newFrom: { 'source' -> path. 'descriptions' -> nodes size. 'objects' -> objectRows size. 'validated' -> true. 'reads' -> readRows asArray } ]
] ] ensure: [ (base , 'pluggable-accessors-roundtrip-mcp-gate.json') asFileReference writeStreamDo: [ :s | s truncate; nextPutAll: '{"complete":true,"nativeResources":false}' ] ].
(base , 'pluggable-accessors-roundtrip-reference.json') asFileReference writeStreamDo: [ :s | s truncate; nextPutAll: (NeoJSONWriter toStringPretty: report) ].
report collect: [ :row | { row at: 'descriptions'. row at: 'objects'. row at: 'validated' } ]
